hero.subcopy: Cybersecurity Analyst with 5+ years in SOC operations, threat detection and incident response across energy, utilities and enterprise environments - turning raw telemetry into containment.

terminalLines.text: > focus    : threat hunting · IR · SIEM engineering

paragraphs: I'm Zeel Chaudhari - a Cybersecurity Analyst with 5+ years of progressive experience across energy, utilities and enterprise environments. At Oncor Electric Delivery, the largest regulated transmission and distribution utility in Texas, I monitor and defend IT/OT infrastructure serving over 10 million customers against DDoS campaigns, malware outbreaks and unauthorized access.

My craft lives in the SIEM - ArcSight, Splunk, LogRhythm - fine-tuning correlation rules until the alerts that fire are the alerts that matter. I've supported two Department of Energy security audits to successful certification, led SOC bridge calls under pressure, and documented the playbooks that make the next response faster than the last.

principles.v: Fine-tuned correlation rules, dashboards and alerts that surface real threats - not noise.
Packet analysis (SNORT), log correlation and malware sandboxing to find root cause.
IP blacklisting, firewall policy and custom rules that shrink exposure fast.
NIST CSF, CIS Controls and SOC 2 alignment proven across DOE audit cycles.

steps.alert: ALERT 09:41:07 - SIEM flags ransomware behaviour on substation host HMI-04

options.label: Reboot the HMI to clear the process
options.feedback: Rebooting destroys volatile evidence. The threat persists in the image.

options.label: Isolate host, capture volatile memory
options.feedback: Correct. Contain first, preserve forensics - blast radius stops here.

options.label: Dismiss - likely a false positive
options.feedback: Ransomware on OT gear is never dismissed. Escalation missed.

steps.alert: HOST ISOLATED - logs show PowerShell spawned by winword.exe, beaconing to 185.220.x.x

options.label: Block hash fleet-wide, blacklist the C2 IP
options.feedback: Correct. Custom containment rules cut command & control across the grid.

options.label: Delete the document, close the ticket
options.feedback: The payload is already staged elsewhere. Ticket closed, breach open.

options.label: Email the user asking what they opened
options.feedback: Every minute of dwell time widens the compromise. Act, then interview.

steps.alert: C2 SEVERED - scope unknown. 400+ endpoints share the same image.

options.label: Restore HMI-04 from backup, move on
options.feedback: Without a retro-hunt you restore blind - sibling infections stay live.

options.label: Retro-hunt IoCs in Splunk, force cred resets
options.feedback: Correct. Full-scope hunt + credential hygiene. Incident closed at root cause.

options.label: Raise the SIEM alert threshold
options.feedback: Quieter dashboards, louder breach. Tuning is not remediation.
